六丁六甲金元帅护身平安符

六丁六甲是道教传统中重要的十二位护法神将，由六丁阴神与六甲阳神组成，具有护法、护身、镇邪、清秽及护佑出行等职能。

六丁六甲金元帅为统摄丁甲兵将的元帅神将，号令六丁六甲护法，护持善信、扫除邪扰、镇护身宅。

本符奉请六丁六甲金元帅及丁甲神将护佑，主要祈求护身平安、护持魂魄、远离惊扰、避邪镇煞、消厄解晦、出行顺遂及吉祥安稳。

什么人适合奉请？

本符适合希望加强日常护身、祈求平安顺遂及远离邪扰不顺的善信奉请。

特别适合容易受惊、夜间经常外出、经常旅行、开车、前往偏远地区或工作环境较复杂者；也适合近期运势不顺、容易遇到口舌是非、虚惊烦扰，希望消厄转顺的人。

平时单纯希望自己或家人平安安稳、出入吉祥、少灾少扰、好运相随者，也适合奉请。

由吉法新道长亲自书写并开光加持

每一道六丁六甲金元帅符均由美国阳翥道教协会会长吉法新道长亲自书写，并亲自依传统道教方式进行开光加持。

每道符均根据奉请人的个人资料进行准备。

购买时请附：姓名、出生年月日时及地址。

使用方法

本款为随身佩戴符，可随身佩戴或随身携带，也可妥善放置于钱包、证件夹、随身包袋等干净安全的位置。

如用于日常出行护佑，也可随身携带。奉请后应妥善保存，避免随意污损、丢弃或放置于不洁之处。

body_en:
Protection, Safety & Good Luck Talisman — Marshal Jin of the Six Ding and Six Jia

The Six Ding and Six Jia are twelve important guardian deities in Taoist tradition, consisting of the Six Ding Yin guardians and the Six Jia Yang guardians. They are traditionally associated with protection, guarding the individual and household, dispelling harmful influences, and supporting safe travel.

Marshal Jin is revered as the commander who leads and directs the Six Ding and Six Jia guardian forces.

This talisman invokes Marshal Jin and the Ding-Jia guardians for personal protection, everyday safety, spiritual stability, relief from misfortune, protection from harmful influences, safe travel, and good fortune.

Who Is This Talisman Suitable For?

This talisman is suitable for anyone seeking stronger everyday protection, peace, safety, and good fortune.

It is especially suitable for those who travel frequently, drive regularly, go out at night, visit remote places, or work in complicated environments.

It may also be requested by those experiencing repeated disturbances, misfortune, difficulties, or unwanted influences, as well as anyone who simply wishes for greater peace, protection, and stability for themselves or their family.

Personally Prepared by Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji

Each talisman is personally hand-drawn by Dpr. Zhouxinyu Ji, President of the Yangzhu Taoist Association of America, and personally consecrated and blessed according to traditional Taoist practice.

Each talisman is prepared using the information of the person requesting it.

When ordering, please provide the full name, date and time of birth, and address.

How to Use

This is a wearable talisman designed to be carried or worn.

It may be respectfully kept in a wallet, document holder, personal bag, or another clean and secure place. It should be carefully preserved and treated respectfully after it is received.
